title: Ofakazi Abaqinile
intro: Cabanga ngesikhathi lapho ukukholwa kwavivinywa ngomlilo, futhi ukuqiniseka okungenakunyakaziswa kwaba ukuphikiswa okukhulu. Unikwe umsebenzi wokwembula ukuthi ungubani iqembu elindaba yalo ilandiswa ku-Quran, indaba yokholo olujulile ngokumelene nobudlova obukhulu. Vula izinkomba ukuze uthole ukuthi bangobani laba bantu, kanye nezimo ezingavamile ababhekene nazo.
clues: Sama siqinile ekuqinisekeni kwethu, naphezu kokucindezelwa okukhulu kokulahla ukholo lwethu.
Sasihlaselwe umbusi onamandla owayefuna ukucima ukukhanya kobuNkulunkulu bukaNkulunkulu oyedwa.
Sabona izibonakaliso ezinkulu nezimangaliso, kodwa abacindezeli bethu bahlala benganaki.
Sabekezelela indlela esabekayo yokushushiswa eyayihloselwe ukwesabisa abanye ukuze bathobele.
Saphonswa esihogweni esivuthayo, kodwa ukuqina kwethu kwasitholela isikhundla esiphakeme no-Allah.
Indaba yethu ilandiswa kuyiSurah eqanjwe ngamaqoqo ezinkanyezi asezulwini, ixwayisa ngesiphetho salabo abashushisa amakholwa.

outcome.label: Isiphetho Sethu Esiphelele
options: Bazuze ukufela ukholo kanye nomvuzo waphakade.
outcome.answer: Bazuze ukufela ukholo kanye nomvuzo waphakade.

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
